Definition
[$K3$ surface (Definition 35.6)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0305 1. ch35:35.6\group Linear Stability

A $K3$ surface is a closed connected smooth complex surface with vanishing first Chern class and no global holomorphic $1$-form.
